# @santi020k/eslint-config-basic

> A comprehensive, composable ESLint 9/10+ Flat Config package for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Astro, Expo, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Solid, Angular, NestJS, Hono, Qwik, Remix, React Router, TanStack Start, Lit, Vite, and Slidev.


## AI Assistant Context

**Role**: Senior Software Engineer / Maintenance Agent.
**Goal**: Ensure code quality, type safety, and seamless Developer Experience (DX).
**Conventions**:
- Strictly Flat Config (no legacy `.eslintrc`).
- Composable design via direct options (`typescript`, `frameworks`, and integration enums).
- **Zero-Config Auto-Detection**: Automatically detects frameworks and plugins from `package.json`. Detected framework configs are enabled by default (reported via `detectedFrameworks`); use `autoFrameworks: false` (or `optionMergeStrategy: 'replace'` with explicit `frameworks`) to opt out, or booleans like `frameworks.react: true` to opt in manually. Explicit options merge with detected/preset values by default.
- **Agent Skill Generator (Beta)**: Automatically generates tailored ESLint standards for AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Aider, Gemini, Cline, Roo Code, Kiro, and `AGENTS.md`-based tools) based on your active config. This is a non-breaking, opt-in feature.
- **Next.js App Router**: Optimized rules for the `app/` directory.
- **Bundled Frameworks (v2)**: Framework configs ship behind the main package — application projects install only `@santi020k/eslint-config-basic` and enable frameworks via booleans or auto-detection.
- **Strict Mode**: `strict: true` promotes all warnings to errors.
- Monorepo using Turborepo and pnpm Workspaces.
- Dependency alignment via pnpm `overrides` with `$` references.
- **Changelog**: Use Changesets (`pnpm run changeset`, commit `.changeset/*.md`); do not edit `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` manually for releases.

## Quick Start

```js
import { eslintConfig } from '@santi020k/eslint-config-basic'

export default await eslintConfig() // Auto-detection enabled by default
```

## Project Architecture

This is a monorepo containing multiple config packages.

- [Full Architecture & Context](./llms-full.txt)
- [Architecture Notes](./apps/docs/src/content/docs/guide/architecture.md)
- [Project Overview](./README.md)
- [CLAUDE.md](./.github/CLAUDE.md) - Claude-specific AI agent guide
- [.agent/skills/](./.agent/skills/) - Specialized workflows for agents

### Core Structure

- `packages/core/` — Base JS config, utilities, and shared types/enums
- `packages/typescript/` — TypeScript rules
- `packages/react/`, `packages/next/` — React ecosystem
- `packages/astro/`, `packages/vue/`, `packages/nuxt/`, `packages/svelte/`, `packages/solid/`, `packages/lit/` — Frontend frameworks and Web Components
- `packages/angular/`, `packages/nest/`, `packages/hono/` — Enterprise, backend, and edge frameworks
- `packages/expo/` — React Native / Expo
- `packages/qwik/`, `packages/remix/`, `packages/react-router/`, `packages/tanstack-start/` — Modern meta-frameworks
- `packages/vite/`, `packages/slidev/` — Vite tooling and Slidev presentations
- `packages/integrations/` — All integrations (tools, libraries, testing, formats, extensions)
- `packages/basic/` — Main entry point composing all packages

| Slidev | `@santi020k/eslint-config-slidev` |

### Supported Integrations

**Testing**: Vitest, Jest, Playwright, Cypress, TestingLibrary
**Tools**: Prettier, CSpell, JSDoc, Swagger, pnpm, Command, Docker, GitHub Actions, Nx
**Libraries**: AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Mastra, MCP, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Tailwind (via `better-tailwindcss`), i18next, Stencil, TanStack Query, TanStack Router, Storybook, TypeORM, Prisma, Drizzle, MikroORM, Sequelize
**Formats**: MDX, Markdown, JSONC, YAML, TOML, GraphQL, CSS (`@eslint/css`), HTML (`@html-eslint`)
**Extensions**: Regexp, Unicorn, SonarJS, Security, Perfectionist, Node (`eslint-plugin-n`), Compat, DeMorgan, Depend, Oxlint, Biome, A11y, BestPractices, Boundaries

## Commands

```bash
pnpm run build       # Build all packages with Turbo
pnpm run lint        # Run ESLint + CSpell + Knip
pnpm run test        # Run integration tests (+ coverage)
pnpm run inspector   # Open ESLint config visualizer
npx @santi020k/eslint-config-basic init # Initialize project configuration
npx @santi020k/eslint-config-basic generate-skill # (Beta) Generate agent standards
npx @santi020k/eslint-config-basic generate-skill --check # CI: fail when agent standards are stale
npx @santi020k/eslint-config-basic generate-skill --create # Scaffold root AGENTS.md when missing
```

## Implementation Workflow

1. Create package in `packages/{name}` with `src/index.ts`.
2. Define rules as `TSESLint.FlatConfig.ConfigArray`.
3. Add enums/types to `packages/core/src/types.ts`.
4. Compose in `packages/basic/src/index.ts`.
5. Add playground under `packages/playground/{name}/`.
6. Update tests in `packages/tests/src/`.
